purpose: 어떤 커밋에 대한 검증 결과도 다른 커밋의 판정으로 둔갑하지 않게 하고, 그 결함이 실제로 존재함을 재현 가능한 detector와 원본 payload로 고정한다.
ultimatePurpose: Verdict(repo, venue, SHA)는 해당 저장소·검증 경로·SHA와 정확히 일치하는 실행 결과만으로 결정한다.

contractBasis.fact: admission-check 발행 권위는 App 5795152이며, 판정 조건은 워크플로 path·이벤트 venue·head_sha·conclusion의 네 조건이다.
Invariant (snapshot consistency): every PR-derived fact remains bound to H even if the PR moves mid-evaluation.
Stale evaluation: Evaluation(H)는 H에만 적용 가능하며, 평가 종료 시 현재 PR head != H이면 STALE_EVALUATION deny.
A0 PR-identity leg: PR API의 head.sha가 headSha 입력과 다르면 fail-closed. 이 거부는 정당하며 유지한다.

contractBasis.note: 이 슬라이스에서 판정 대상 결속 계약을 신설하고, '현재 head에 failure 발행은 올바르다'는 모순 문장을 교체했다.

definitions.externalId: 특정 run·attempt를 가리키는 상관관계 식별자. 실행 신원 전체가 아니며(workflow_id·venue 미포함), GitHub는 external_id와 실제 Actions Run의 일치를 보증하지 않는다.

authoritySources.consistencyOnly: check-run output.summary — 권위가 아니라 위 기록과의 일관성 검증 자료

modes: --self-test (no network; 10 fixtures: PR INCIDENT/CLEAN/EMPTY + MG CLEAN/VIOLATION/UNRESOLVED + path suffix eligible/not-eligible + coverage/ratio-null)

eligibleScope.pathNormalization: workflow_run.path is compared after truncating everything from the first `@` (equivalent to ${RAW_PATH%%@*}). Quirk SSOT: docs/spec/ci_provider_failover_quirks.md Q6.
eligibleScope.runs: path(normalized)=.github/workflows/admission-gate-v2.yml AND event=pull_request AND status=completed AND head_sha in --sha set
eligibleScope.checkRuns: app.id=5795152 AND name=admission-check AND external_id venue=pull_request
eligibleScope.excluded: external_id venue=merge_group (`v1|`) is out of scope and counted separately; it is never judged a violation.

merge_group.runs: path(normalized)=.github/workflows/admission-gate-v2.yml AND event=merge_group AND status=completed AND head_sha in --sha set
merge_group.checkRuns: app.id=5795152 AND name=admission-check AND external_id prefix `v1|`
merge_group.runIdentity: external_id carries no run id, so it is resolved from run=/attempt= in output.summary and cross-checked against the Actions Run API. Unresolvable is V2-UNRESOLVED -> exit 2.
merge_group.excluded: external_id prefix `v1p|` (pull_request) is out of scope and counted separately; it is not judged a violation.

invariants.V2: external_id의 run 신원을 Actions Run API와 교차 대조: id, run_attempt(필요 시 /attempts/{n}), repo id, head_sha, workflow path, event venue
invariants.V3: 적격 run마다 external_id가 그 run을 지목하는 PR-venue check-run이 정확히 1개(대응 관계의 완전성)
invariants.V4: 0 <= t(check completed) - t(run completed) <= max_lag. 미완료가 max_lag 초과면 PENDING, run 완료 전 완료되면 PREMATURE
invariants.V5: summary의 run/attempt/evaluated_commit은 일관성 검증용. A: summary run != external_id run, B: evaluated_commit != run head_sha, C: attempt 불일치

perSubject.UNRESOLVED: exit 2 (zero eligible runs, or V2-UNRESOLVED/V4-UNVERIFIABLE present)

coverage.resolvedDefinition: resolved = count of RESOLVED_CLEAN + RESOLVED_VIOLATION subjects
coverage.violationsDefinition: violations = count of RESOLVED_VIOLATION subjects (not the total number of violation rows)
coverage.coverageRatio: resolved/(resolved+unresolved); null when the denominator is 0
coverage.resultInvariant: PASS requires subjects>0, unresolved==0, and violations==0. With an UNRESOLVED subject and no definite violation the result is UNVERIFIABLE (exit 2) instead of PASS. A definite violation yields FAIL (exit 1), and unresolved subjects do not mask it.
coverage.oneExitCode: one invocation emits a single exit code. Per-SHA attribution is read from per-SHA invocations or from coverage.perSubject.

thresholds.notClaimed: GitHub가 규정한 사실이 아니다. GitHub는 check-run 완료 기한을 규정하지 않으며, 14일 경과 시 GitHub가 conclusion=stale을 부여한다.
thresholds.appliedBy: detector 기본값 및 이 실행의 --max-lag-seconds 생략 값

incidents.summary: head A 실행의 failure가 새 head B의 check-run에 기록됐고, B 자신의 run success는 발행되지 않았다.

checkRuns.note: 자기 run을 정당하게 지목했지만 run 완료 후에도 종료되지 않았다(V4-PENDING). summary에 attempt/venue/evaluated_commit 줄이 없다.
external_id는 run B를, summary는 run A를 지목한다(V5A). 자기 run B 완료 262초 전에 failure로 종료됐다(V4-PREMATURE). run B의 success는 이 SHA에 발행된 check-run이 없다.

incidents.summary: 이전 head의 run failure가 새 head check-run에 기록됐다.

newRun.note: 동일 run의 attempt 2는 failure(06:21:56Z)다. attempt별 조회 없이는 attempt 1의 성공을 볼 수 없다.

checkRuns.note: summary는 run 44683280133(b644590d)을 지목한다(V5A). 자기 run attempt 1 완료 294초 전에 failure로 종료됐다(V4-PREMATURE).

incidents.summary: 이전 run attempt 2의 failure가 새 head check-run에 기록됐다.

checkRuns.note: summary는 run attempt 2를 지목한다(V5A, V5C). 자기 run 완료 327초 전에 failure로 종료됐다(V4-PREMATURE). 이후 대체 check-run이 없다.

observed.note: 적격 PR-venue run이 없으므로 정상(0)이 아니라 검증 불가(2)다. merge_group check-run은 범위 밖으로 제외됐다.
For each head, exactly one eligible merge_group run and one subject check-run were confirmed. Details in §mergeGroupObservation.

determination.creationBinding: CORRECT — 3사건의 external_id는 모두 자기 실행(run·attempt)을 정확히 지목했다. V1/V2 위반은 0건이다.
determination.completionBinding: VIOLATED — 3사건 모두 check-run의 summary가 다른 run을 지목하고(V5A), 그 check-run은 자기 run 완료 전에 terminal failure가 됐다(V4-PREMATURE).
determination.correspondence: CONFIRMED — 적격 run 5개에 대해 V3-MISSING/DUPLICATE는 0건이다. 결함은 '대응 없음'이 아니라 '완료 시점의 오귀속'이다.
determination.headMoveGuard: UPHELD — A0 PR-identity leg는 head 이동 시 인증서 발급을 거부했다(certificate-mint.yml:1553). 이 거부는 수정 대상이 아니다.
determination.residualDefect: Admission App 5795152가 run 완료 시점의 현재 PR head로 check-run 대상을 해소한다. 이 저장소는 App 소스·설치 토큰이 없어 수리할 수 없다(GET /repos/Archright/Axiom/installation → 401).

unknowns: 동일 run attempt의 중복 webhook/retry에서도 재현되는지 UNKNOWN

merge_group venue completion misbinding: OBSERVED — V-A (check-run 133843210523, G=13becf27) shows binding to a probe-merge-queue run and terminal completion 361s early. The separate 9-head sample was RESOLVED_CLEAN throughout (§mergeGroupObservation).
UNKNOWN whether, and at what point, the App closes a superseded run's check-run as cancelled
UNOBSERVED whether delayed or duplicated delivery of G1's completion event can invert G2's verdict under merge_group
limits: detector는 저장소 측 관측 도구다. App을 수리하지 않으며, 오귀속된 check-run을 자동 복구하지 않는다.
detector는 CI gate에 연결하지 않았다. 연결하면 App 수리 전까지 모든 PR이 RED가 되므로, 이 슬라이스는 관측·증거·handoff까지만 담당한다.
600초 임계값은 운영 SLO다. GitHub 규정이 아니며 summary.json에 적용값으로 기록했다.
expectedLiveResult: RED until Admission App 5795152 fixes verdict-subject binding (completion-time check-run selection must use the execution's immutable head_sha, not the current PR head)

invariantsHeld.certificateMintUnchanged: sha256 equals origin/main version; this slice does not touch .github/workflows/certificate-mint.yml

externalAuthorityOutOfReach: GitHub Ruleset 판정 자체 (위임 대상이며 재구현하지 않는다)

mergeGroupObservation.sample: 9 heads that have a merge_group run. Each head has exactly one eligible run in that venue and exactly one subject check-run.

incidents.fact: check-run 133843210523 is published on G=13becf27, but its summary points at probe-merge-queue run 44025040322. That check-run reached terminal (failure) 361s before the G's only eligible admission-gate run 44025040389 completed.

The summary has no run= line, so run identity cannot be resolved. It has been in_progress for 3.36 days after run 44212842619 completed (2026-11-18T01:12:47Z); the detector judges V2-UNRESOLVED -> exit 2.

The check-run closed 6s after run completion (2026-11-21T08:26:37Z vs run.updated_at 08:26:31Z). It was in-flight for 614s, inside max_lag=600. The audit summary's 604s does not recompute from the current payload's started_at->completed_at (614s).

completed_at (2026-11-20T13:12:58Z) precedes started_at (2026-11-20T13:12:59Z) by 1s, and external_id is empty. The same head's admission-gate run 44741298189 succeeded. The summary records that there was no in_progress check.

detector.note: No dedicated inverted-timestamp code exists. The detector judges the missing external_id as V2-MALFORMED, and because the venue then cannot be resolved it counts in-scope check-runs as 0.

mergeGroupObservation.fact: merge_group can be judged by the same detector, and completion-time misbinding occurs there as in the PR venue (V-A). The 9-head sample is entirely RESOLVED_CLEAN, so this does not claim merge_group is normal in general — it is a sample result.
mergeGroupObservation.payloadIndex: payloads/mg/<sha>/runs.json (Actions runs, head_sha filter) + payloads/mg/<sha>/check-runs.json (commit check-runs, filter=all). Fields are limited to id/attempt/event/path/head_sha/conclusion and check-run id/status/conclusion/timestamps/external_id/summary.
